items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Andrew Anderson. I played with, I played with them. Trumpet players.

ctx.x: Andy Anderson went about a year ago, I know. He was going down there.

Andrew Anderson. I played with, I played with them. Trumpet players. I forget who else was in the band. I worked in Delacue Island too. I worked down there. But not, not, not regular. I worked down there a couple of nights, I mean.
That's on this side over the other side. Yeah, about the Salmon Hall.
